column1: # strip-quotes.awk cases. TAB-separated: label, input, needle, present(yes|no)
# \n in the input column is expanded to a newline — the runner uses printf %b.
# DOUBLE every other backslash you mean literally: %b also consumes \t, \0,
# \xHH and, worst of all, \c, which means "stop output here" and silently
# truncates the case. That has produced three test cases that passed or failed
# for reasons in the corpus rather than in the lexer
# (Governance/TROUBLESHOOTING.md, entry Q). Test DATA lives here rather
# than in run.sh so that a case containing a command substitution is data a
# shell never parses, and so that adding a case needs no shell knowledge.
double-quoted message is dropped
single-quoted message is dropped
quoted lone flag is kept
single-quoted lone flag is kept
command substitution is scanned
substitution inside quotes is scanned
nested quotes inside a substitution pair correctly
the apostrophe idiom does not invert the rest
line continuation reads as the shell reads it
heredoc body is dropped
quoted heredoc body is dropped
escaped flag survives
unterminated quote is not matched raw
plain command is untouched
quoted bare word is kept
quoted phrase is still dropped
eval argument is scanned as code
shell -c argument is scanned as code
backslash inside a flag resolves as the shell resolves it
leading backslash still yields the flag
short option bundle ending in c is command text
ANSI-C quoting drops its dollar
locale quoting drops its dollar
hex escapes decode
octal escapes decode
brace expansion is expanded
alias value is scanned as code
ANSI-C newline makes a phrase, which is dropped
brace group with no comma is left alone
escaped apostrophe does not close an ANSI-C region
quoted brace group is left literal
escaped brace is left literal
a range group is expanded
exceeding the alternative bound emits the limit marker
increment range is expanded not deleted
comma wins over the range separator
control escape truncates at NUL as the shell does
control escape leaves the flag intact
heredoc tag has its quotes removed
an unfound heredoc terminator is refused, not dropped
